models.limits: Checks an atomic abstract transaction and one immutable pair of policy decisions per delivery. A bucket lifetime fingerprint is assumed distinct for the single ordinary recreation; actual wall-clock buckets.created plus region does not prove ABA resistance under clock rollback. One abstract cache line does not model concrete multi-entry quotas, exact paths, TTL seconds, SQL/triggers/locking, authentication, HTTP/XML/S3 parsing, cache buffers, ETags or Go refinement. Restart preserves abstract committed state only, not crash durability. Native and SDK tests separately cover the real implementation.
